newsitem.title: USA: Palomar Medical expects Q3 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Palomar Medical expects Q3 shr loss.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said Monday it expects to post record revenues in the third quarter of $25 million, while its projected loss should narrow to $0.15 per share for the period.
That compares to revenues of $17 million and a net loss of $0.32 loss of per share during this year's second quarter.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported revenues of $5.9 million, and a net loss of $1.9 million, or $0.14 per share.
"The substantial growth in revenues is due to the rapid market acceptance of our new laser and electronic products," Palomar Chairman and Chief Executive Steven Georgiev said in a statement.
Georgiev added that its operating performance has improved, leading to a "substantially smaller" net loss between this year's third and second quarters.
